scripts.wasm: pnpm wasm:media && pnpm wasm:pdf && pnpm wasm:docs && pnpm wasm:raster
scripts.wasm:media: RUSTFLAGS="--remap-path-prefix=$HOME=~" cargo build -p hexscope-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --profile wasm --no-default-features --features svg && wasm-bindgen target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/wasm/hexscope_wasm.wasm --target web --remove-name-section --remove-producers-section --out-dir apps/web/src/wasm-media --out-name hexscope_media
scripts.wasm:pdf: RUSTFLAGS="--remap-path-prefix=$HOME=~" cargo build -p hexscope-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --profile wasm --no-default-features --features pdf && wasm-bindgen target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/wasm/hexscope_wasm.wasm --target web --remove-name-section --remove-producers-section --out-dir apps/web/src/wasm-pdf --out-name hexscope_pdf
scripts.wasm:docs: RUSTFLAGS="--remap-path-prefix=$HOME=~" cargo build -p hexscope-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --profile wasm --no-default-features --features office,mail,module && wasm-bindgen target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/wasm/hexscope_wasm.wasm --target web --remove-name-section --remove-producers-section --out-dir apps/web/src/wasm-docs --out-name hexscope_docs
scripts.wasm:raster: RUSTFLAGS="--remap-path-prefix=$HOME=~" cargo build -p hexscope-raster --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --profile wasm --no-default-features --features web && wasm-bindgen target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/wasm/hexscope_raster.wasm --out-dir apps/web/src/wasm-raster --target web --remove-name-section --remove-producers-section
